page.overview:
Who is Bernadette Fromage?

Bernadette Bouvier (née Fromage) was married to Erique Bouvier and had 2 children René Bouvier and Jipsum Bouvier.

She is Marge's great-grandaunt-in-law, and Bart, Lisa, and Maggie's great-great-grandaunt-in-law.

Fromage translates as Cheese in English.
